international.title: Man charged after two people die in Leeds police pursuit crash
international.summary: Leigh Ross, 39, charged with causing death by dangerous driving after BMW being pursued by police collided with another car A man has been charged with causing death by dangerous driving after two people were killed when their car was hit by a vehicle being chased by police. A 22-year-old man and 23-year-old woman, both from York, died when their car was struck by a BMW being pursued by police in Leeds in the early hours of Sunday. Continue reading...
